▲◀▶▼

Move with WASD or arrow keys. Walk into an Octocat to collect it. I opens the Octodex, M toggles music, 1–4 pick a move in battle, H uses a Hotfix, R a Revert, S switches Octocat. Code beats Ops, Ops beats Security, Security beats Code. Your progress is saved in this browser.
